uncheckable.heading: Could not be checked ({count})
uncheckable.gpuLengthWithCard: The length of the card you selected is unknown, so case clearance could not be checked. The chip's reference measurement was deliberately not substituted: custom-design cards are longer than the reference card, and a check made with that figure would give false confidence. Confirm the card's dimensions on the manufacturer's page.
uncheckable.gpuLengthChipOnly: The graphics card's length is unknown, so case clearance could not be checked. Confirm the card's physical dimensions on the manufacturer's page.
uncheckable.gpuTdpFromReference: The total board power (TBP) of the card you selected has not been published. The power calculation used the chip's reference figure — custom-design cards can draw somewhat more than the reference.
uncheckable.psuLength: The power supply's length is unknown, so case clearance could not be checked. Confirm it on the manufacturer's page.
